quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Asset-heavy rail infrastructure: Operating ROIC of 15.96% preserved representing physical rail network capital (tracks, locomotives, classification yards) with zero goodwill distortion. Peak Owner EPS of $11.98 in FY2025 is clean operational earning power under PSR execution. 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth of 7.0% driven by 1.5% carload volume, 2.5% core pricing above inflation, 1.0% PSR productivity, and 2.5% buybacks, offset by 0.5% capex/regulatory friction. Balance sheet carries $31.81B LT debt (4.46x NI) supported by irreplaceable corridor assets, 7.52x EBIT interest coverage, and 98.3% FCF conversion.
